$comment: Pronunciation and spoken-form lexicon for Agency 2026 narration and announcements. 'write' is the form to put in a narration field; 'say' is how it should sound. 'status: verify' means nobody has listened to it in the approved voices yet: render a short clip, listen, then set 'checked' with the date. Add every new product name, acronym, place and person's name here before voicing (guides/NARRATION.md, Pronunciation). Never guess a person's name: ask the person how it is said.

entries.note: Full name on first mention: the Ministry of Technology and Innovation. Never 'T and I' or 'TI' in speech.
Never 'GoA' in speech or on screen for the public.
Spelled with the accent on screen and in narration; the voice says the English form.
Acknowledgement wording is supplied by the event owner and read word for word. Never write or edit it.
On first spoken use in a film: 'artificial intelligence, or AI'. Event names keep 'AI' as written.
Use 'AI agent' wherever people in the story are also called agents (guides/WRITING.md, AI terms).
Narration spells out every web address; the screen shows alberta.ca.
Say 'questions from the audience', not 'Q and A'.
